Adaptations live OUTSIDE this copy: reviewed foreground masks, calibration,
rectification, synchronized metric poses, visibility-supported hull export,
baseline/parallax/reprojection checks, real-object data splits, and read-only
ROS1 supervised viewpoint requests. Supplied synthetic RGB-D renderer is only
a dependency of original frontend.py; no depth frames are used by the adapter.
gaussian_world.py supplies GaussianRenderStats; its legacy RGB-D world is not
used. The CPU SE3 map receives only supported single-RGB visual-hull proxy depth.
The original planner is wrapped with measured-candidate, FOV, visibility and
duplicate-view gates. No future real camera frames are used for scoring.
